description: This file defines the ProductImageService interface, which declares methods for managing product images such as adding, retrieving, removing, and updating images within a product catalog system.

classes.name: ProductImageService
classes.description: Interface for managing product images, including adding, retrieving, removing, and updating images for products.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Adds a product image to persistence and updates content management system.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves the image content and description from CMS for a specific product image and size.

methods.name: getProductImages
methods.description: Returns all images for a given product.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a product image.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves an image file by store code, product code, filename, and size, used by the image servlet.

methods.name: addProductImages
methods.description: Adds multiple images to a product.
